name: @kostysh/skills
description: Интерактивная установка и обновление скилов kostysh/skills

scripts.format: biome format --write src test package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
scripts.format:check: biome check --formatter-enabled=true --linter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false src test package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
scripts.lint: biome lint src test package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && eslint src test vite.config.ts && pnpm typecheck
